verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly shows that error events carry tags, context and user data. Search queries filter errors by tag. The JS packages mention "event context" configuration options. The MCP error investigation can "see affected users". Nothing explicitly documents an SDK API for attaching these, and breadcrumbs are never mentioned. missing for 10: explicit breadcrumbs capture, documented SDK API for setting custom tags and user context on every event, evidence the stack trace view shows this state, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach breadcrumbs, custom tags, and user context to every event so a stack trace arrives with the state that produced it

citations.quote: take advantage of new configuration options for event correlation, event context, handlers, and more
view occurrences and stack traces, see affected users
find previously-occurred errors by type, location, meta-data and many other attributes.
